producer.name: MÙA Craft Saké
producer.location: District 3, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
producer.about: MÙA Craft Saké is a small sake brewery and taproom in District 3 of Ho Chi Minh City. It was formed in 2022 by three partners: the Japanese sake brewery Heiwa Shuzo, the Vietnamese craft brewer East West Brewing and the restaurant Mùa Trà Quế. Press describe it as Vietnam's first craft sake brewery.
